instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Digital marketing agency specializing in social media strategy, influencer campaign management, and content production for lifestyle, beauty, and fashion brands. The firm manages extensive campaigns across music festivals, streaming services, and digital publishing platforms.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate. We are losing market share to faster-moving competitors and need to reignite our growth trajectory by capturing emerging influencer markets. We are willing to make significant strategic bets, potentially including M&A of niche content studios or geographic expansion into high-growth Asian entertainment hubs.
answers.additionalContext: We are 3 months into fundraising conversations with growth equity investors who are conducting deep due diligence on our technology and operations. Their feedback indicates concern about our digital maturity relative to peers. We need to quickly identify and launch 2-3 innovation initiatives that will address these concerns and strengthen our fundraising narrative.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Predictive Content Performance Suite
opportunities.rationale: Implementing AI for content performance prediction directly addresses investor concerns about technology maturity and provides a clear revenue driver by optimizing ad spend across high-volume campaigns. This leverages existing data engineering capabilities.

first_actions: Pilot 3 new AI models in Q1 focusing on influencer campaign ROI forecasting
Allocate 5% of budget for specialized ML talent acquisition/consultancy
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase campaign conversion rate by 15% within 6 months.
milestones: M2: Integration into primary client workflow (4 months)

opportunities.title: Acquisition of Niche Streaming/Creator IP Portfolio
opportunities.rationale: Given the high competitive pressure, acquiring a portfolio of established niche content creators or smaller streaming platforms offers an immediate shortcut to market share and diversification. This is a bold move that aligns perfectly with the 'growth' mandate.

first_actions: Establish M&A scouting team focused on undervalued vertical niches (e.g., interactive AR entertainment)
Develop preliminary valuation models for 3 target companies
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful acquisition of a portfolio generating $5M in annualized recurring revenue (ARR).
milestones: M1: Target list finalized and initial outreach complete (2 months)
M2: Due diligence completed and LOI signed (6 months)

next_steps.action: Conduct deep dive due diligence on 3 potential M&A targets and define the integration roadmap.
Finalize technical requirements for the AI content prediction suite MVP to align with fundraising expectations.
Host an internal workshop on 'Radical Growth Scenarios' to challenge current operational constraints.

key_weaknesses: Partial innovation process leads to inconsistent funding prioritization and slow execution cycles.
Low digital maturity (Level 3) presents a significant gap in demonstrating scalable technology readiness to growth equity investors.
Reliance on a small leadership team increases the risk of 'strategy' being bottlenecked by internal decision-making constraints.
Overly rigid formal business case approval chain stifles necessary speed and agility required for high competitive pressure.
